metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Vietnam between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products - MODIS: MODIS/006/MOD14A1 (Terra) or MYD14A1 (Aqua) - daily - VIIRS: FIRMS dataset via MODIS/006/VNP14IMGML - near real-time - Date range: 2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28 (inclusive) - Location: Country boundaries for Cambodia and Vietnam 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire detection products - Focus on fire confidence levels (high/nominal confidence) - Filter by confidence to avoid false positives 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If both countries have valid fire counts (including 0), compare them → A or B - If collections are empty → C1 - If processing fails or returns None → C3 - Valid zero fire count is acceptable (means no fires, not an error) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]] ]) vietnam = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.1, 8.5], [109.5, 8.5], [109.5, 23.4], [102.1, 23.4], [102.1, 8.5]] ]) start_date = '2016-08-01' end_date = '2018-02-28' # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire # Using MOD14A1 (Terra) - daily 1km fire product fire_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .select('FireMask') # Check if collection has data col_size = fire_col.size().getInfo() print(f"Fire collection size: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No fire data available for the period.") print("C1") else: # 3. Process fire detections for each country # FireMask values: 0-2=no fire, 3-9=fire with varying confidence # We count pixels with fire (value >= 3) def count_fires(geometry, name): # Sum all fire pixels (FireMask >= 3 indicates fire) fire_sum = fire_col.map(lambda img: img.gte(3)).sum() # Count fire pixels in the region fire_count = fire_sum.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geometry, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('FireMask') count_val = fire_count.getInfo() print(f"{name} fire detections: {count_val}") return count_val cambodia_fires = count_fires(cambodia, "Cambodia") vietnam_fires = count_fires(vietnam, "Vietnam") # 4. Validation & Final Answer if cambodia_fires is None or vietnam_fires is None: print("Calculation failed to return valid results.") print("C3") else: print(f"\nComparison: Cambodia={int(cambodia_fires)}, Vietnam={int(vietnam_fires)}") if cambodia_fires > vietnam_fires: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]]
])

vietnam = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.1, 8.5], [109.5, 8.5], [109.5, 23.4], [102.1, 23.4], [102.1, 8.5]]
])

start_date = '2016-08-01'
end_date = '2018-02-28'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire
# Using MOD14A1 (Terra) - daily 1km fire product
fire_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .select('FireMask')

# Check if collection has data
col_size = fire_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Fire collection size: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No fire data available for the period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Process fire detections for each country
    # FireMask values: 0-2=no fire, 3-9=fire with varying confidence
    # We count pixels with fire (value >= 3)
    
    def count_fires(geometry, name):
        # Sum all fire pixels (FireMask >= 3 indicates fire)
        fire_sum = fire_col.map(lambda img: img.gte(3)).sum()
        
        # Count fire pixels in the region
        fire_count = fire_sum.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=geometry,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('FireMask')
        
        count_val = fire_count.getInfo()
        print(f"{name} fire detections: {count_val}")
        return count_val
    
    cambodia_fires = count_fires(cambodia, "Cambodia")
    vietnam_fires = count_fires(vietnam, "Vietnam")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if cambodia_fires is None or vietnam_fires is None:
        print("Calculation failed to return valid results.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"\nComparison: Cambodia={int(cambodia_fires)}, Vietnam={int(vietnam_fires)}")
        
        if cambodia_fires > vietnam_fires:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]]
])

vietnam = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.1, 8.5], [109.5, 8.5], [109.5, 23.4], [102.1, 23.4], [102.1, 8.5]]
])

start_date = '2016-08-01'
end_date = '2018-02-28'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Fire Product
fire_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .select('FireMask')

col_size = fire_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Fire images: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No fire data available.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Process fire detections
    # FireMask: 3-9 = fire detections
    # Create binary fire mask and sum across time
    fire_binary = fire_col.map(lambda img: img.gte(3))
    total_fires = fire_binary.sum()
    
    # Count fire detections for Cambodia with larger scale
    cambodia_result = total_fires.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=cambodia,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
        bestEffort=True
    )
    cambodia_fires = cambodia_result.get('FireMask').getInfo()
    
    # Count fire detections for Vietnam
    vietnam_result = total_fires.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=vietnam,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
        bestEffort=True
    )
    vietnam_fires = vietnam_result.get('FireMask').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Cambodia fires: {cambodia_fires}")
    print(f"Vietnam fires: {vietnam_fires}")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if cambodia_fires is None or vietnam_fires is None:
        print("Calculation failed.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif cambodia_fires == 0 and vietnam_fires == 0:
        print("No fire pixels detected in either country.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Result: CAM={int(cambodia_fires)} vs VNM={int(vietnam_fires)}")
        
        if cambodia_fires > vietnam_fires:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
